params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Amumu's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--on-hit? on-attack? on-damage?--> and ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' are empowered to mark enemies with ''Curse'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and ''{{ais|Despair|Amumu}}'' per-tick damage.
params.description2: ''Cursed'' targets receive {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' true damage}}}} from all incoming {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|magic damage}}.
params.notes:
* The additional damage inherits tags from the source, and attaches {{tip|proc damage}} to it.
* If the triggering basic attack from '''Amumu''' applies {{as|magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, ''Curse'' will be applied before the {{as|magic damage}}.
* The ''Curse'' application from ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' happens after the {{as|magic damage}} is dealt by it, therefore amplifying the damage only if the target was also already marked before the hit.
* Neutral units / enemies affected by the ''Curse'' can receive bonus damage from the opposing team of '''Amumu''' / neutral units, but the damage will be credited to '''Amumu'''.
* The application of ''Curse'' on ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' is negated if the ability is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Amumu}} basic attacks and ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' mark enemies with ''Curse''. ''{{ai|Despair|Amumu}}'' will refresh ongoing ''Curse'' marks on enemies hit.
params.blurb2: ''Curse'' targets take {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} from incoming {{as|magic damage}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' throws a bandage in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second and {{tip|dash|pulling}} him to them, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
params.description2: '''Amumu''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Bandage Toss'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Despair|Amumu}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.notes:
* '''Amumu''' will track the target if they change locations.
** He will dash to the target's previous location if the target is 2000 or more units away or moves beyond {{tt|2000|Estimated}} units.
* ''Bandage Toss'' will always be directed towards the target's location even if '''Amumu''' moves while it is in flight.
* {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} effects will not prevent '''Amumu''' from commencing the {{tip|dash}}.
* ''Bandage Toss'' does not fizzle on '''Amumu's''' {{tip|death}}, and can still stun and damage enemies.
* '''Amumu''' is still able to {{tip|dash}} even if ''Bandage Toss'' is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* '''Amumu''' will be ordered to basic attack the target upon completion of the dash.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Amumu}} throws a bandage that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} the first enemy hit while he {{tip|dash|dashes}} to them.
params.blurb2: '''Amumu''' periodically [[stock]]s a charge of ''Bandage Toss'', up to 2.

params.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Amumu''' cries a continuous pool of tears, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|5 {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5 to 1}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
params.description2: ''Despair'' is toggled off automatically if '''Amumu''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
params.notes:
* Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Despite the rounding in ''Despair's'' tooltip, it will deal increased damage for every point of {{tt|ability power|+0.0025% per 1 AP}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Toggle:}} {{ci|Amumu}} begins crying, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.

leveling.label: Magic Damage Per Tick
leveling.raw: 5 {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5 to 1}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Amumu''' reduces every instance of {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} taken, capped at 50% of the damage instance.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Reduction|{{ap|5 to 13}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' releases his anger, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description3: ''Tantrum's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.75}} seconds whenever '''Amumu''' is hit by a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
params.notes:
* A {{tip|basic attack}}'s {{tip|basic damage}} and each {{tip|on-hit}} effect are all separate damage instances, and may be reduced each if they deal {{as|physical damage}}.
* ''Tantrum's'' cooldown reduction will trigger multiple times for effects such as {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} and {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} ''Phantom Hit''.
** The cooldown will be reduced, even if the incoming attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
** The cooldown will not be reduced, if the incoming attack misses due to the enemy being {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Amumu}} gains damage reduction against {{as|physical damage}}. {{sti|cd|''Tantrum's''}} cooldown is reduced whenever he is hit by a {{tip|basic attack}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' releases his anger, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
